'''Neb Neb Goodrow''' was a bongo [[Racer/Legends|racer]] who along with fellow racer [[Spleed Nukkels]] was accused of collision, endangering the lives of others, and giving the sport a bad name. Racers [[Zak Quiglee]], [[Friggy Squig]] and [[Tup Tup Grizbain]] tried to get them banned, but their charges were rejected by the [[Gungan race commissioner]].

Goodrow later participated in the [[Otoh Gunga Challenge]]. Neb Neb wasn't in the lead at the beginning but quickly caught up. However, later in the race Goodrow collided with Spleed, and lost the race.
